general.title: GSEA Filter Legacy
general.instructions:
Filter GSEA enrichment results from OMIX GSEA by p-value, enrichment score, pathway size, and more.

**Input options:**
- Upload a CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS file directly, OR
- Use the attached demo data asset, OR
- Replace the data asset with your own

**Interactive HTML table output** includes clickable MSigDB pathway links and column filters for exploration.

datasets.name: GSEA Results
datasets.description: Demo data asset containing gsea_results.csv from OMIX GSEA. Replace with your own or upload a file below (upload takes priority).

categories.name: Input Data
categories.description: Upload GSEA results or use the attached data asset

categories.name: Statistical Filters
categories.description: Filter by statistical thresholds and top-ranked pathways

categories.name: Advanced Annotation Filters
categories.description: Optionally filter by pathway size, collections, pathways, or genes

categories.name: Contrast Filters
categories.description: Optionally keep or remove selected experimental contrasts

parameters.name: GSEA Results File
parameters.description: Optional direct upload of a CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS GSEA results table. A direct upload takes priority over attached data assets.

parameters.name: P-value Type
parameters.description: Use adjusted p-value (recommended) for FDR-corrected results, or raw p-value for specialized analyses.

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.description: Maximum selected p-value to include. Pathways with values less than or equal to this threshold are retained.

parameters.name: Enrichment Score Type
parameters.description: Choose normalized enrichment score (NES) or raw enrichment score (ES).

parameters.name: Enrichment Score Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum absolute NES or ES. Use 0 to disable enrichment-score filtering.

parameters.name: Enrichment Direction
parameters.description: +/- retains both directions, + retains positive enrichment, and - retains negative enrichment.

parameters.name: Size Filter Type
parameters.description: Apply the minimum size to the full pathway or to its leading edge.

parameters.name: Minimum Size
parameters.description: Minimum pathway or leading-edge size. Use 0 to disable size filtering.

parameters.name: Top Rank Filter
parameters.description: Use all or a positive numeric rank applied within each contrast and collection.

parameters.name: Collections to Include
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated collection names, matched exactly. Leave blank for all collections.

parameters.name: Pathways to Include
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated pathway names, matched exactly. Leave blank for all pathways.

parameters.name: Gene Filter Universe
parameters.description: Search for requested genes in the leading edge or in the complete pathway gene set.

parameters.name: Genes to Include
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated gene symbols. A pathway is retained when any requested gene occurs in the selected universe.

parameters.name: Contrast Filter Mode
parameters.description: none includes all contrasts, keep includes only named contrasts, and remove excludes named contrasts.

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated contrast names used with keep or remove mode.
